WITH per_race_gains AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    cs.constructorId,
    r.year,
    r.round,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(
      LAG(cs.wins) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
        ORDER BY r.round
      ),
      0
    ) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins
  FROM per_race_gains
  GROUP BY country
),
all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_all
  FROM country_averages
),
above_all AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, am.mean_all
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.mean_all
),
above_all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_above_all
  FROM above_all
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_wins, aa.mean_all, aam.mean_above_all
  FROM above_all AS aa
  CROSS JOIN above_all_mean AS aam
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > aam.mean_above_all
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_final_average_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - mean_all) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean,
  AVG(avg_wins - mean_above_all) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean
FROM final_countries;

assumptions.assumption: A constructor's previous round means its immediately preceding available constructorStandings row in the same season, ordered by race round; if no earlier standings row exists, the prior wins value is 0.
